items.title: 8.5.3 How to Protect Your Intellectual Property (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of protecting IP (PDF 203-204).

items: Patents: Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan (IPO Pakistan) ke zariye patent ki darkhwast.
Trademarks: apna brand naam, logo ya slogan register karein ta ke doosre istemal na kar sakein.
Copyrights: takhleeqi kaam munasib idare ke saath register kar ke bachayein.
Trade secrets: qeemti karobari maloomat raaz rakhein aur non-disclosure agreements jaise qanooni muahide istemal karein.

blocks.text: Pakistan samait kai mulkon mein copyright kaam bante hi khud maujood hota hai; registration ikhtiyari hai magar milkiyat ka mufeed saboot deti hai. Yeh nukta aam ilm hai.

blocks.explanation: (c) maloomat raaz rakh kar aur qanooni muahidon se; register ya shaya karna use zahir kar dega.

items: IP bachayein: IPO Pakistan mein patent aur trademark registration, copyright, trade secrets ke liye raazdari.
